svg.title: compose-pr · preview · 100x30
svg.text: Create PR and Edit PR open as the compose sheet: one-row fields with their labels on the
left, the branch row with Base, Compare and Draft on one line, the description under
Write and Preview tabs, and Reviewers as one row until it has focus.
The old dialog was a 36-row frame over 59 rows of content: the Create button was below
the fold, and at 100x30 only one row of the description showed.
